name: two-tip
title: Two tip
description: BIOBUZZ 2-tip auto, pollen only: 16 pollen in 4 volleys of 4. Preload into the south cell; sweep the RED garden and score again for tip 1 (8 pollen, team rule); take flower0's 4 and score them in the north cell, which is up after the tip; take flower1's 4 and score again for tip 2; park. Written for RED and mirrored for BLUE (point symmetry).

steps.notes: Straight north, nose-first, to the spot south of the hive.

steps.name: spinUp
steps.notes: Spins the pollen shooter up while driving.
Drive out and spin up at the same time.

to.provenance: SET BY HAND: planning choice; half an inch on: a turn on the spot to face the south cell

steps.notes: Turns the last few degrees on the spot to face the south cell.

steps.name: score
steps.notes: Volley 1: the 4 preloaded pollen into the south cell (4 of the 8 that tip it, team rule).

to.provenance: SET BY HAND: planning choice; 1 in along the next leg's start: a turn on the spot toward the garden

steps.notes: Turns on the spot to face along the leg to the garden.

to.provenance: SET BY HAND: planning choice; west of the score spot, where a 16.8 in turning circle clears the west wall

steps.notes: Nose-first west toward the garden.

to.provenance: SET BY HAND: planning choice; 1 in along the next leg's start: a turn on the spot to face south

steps.notes: Turns on the spot to face south, intake toward the garden line.

Slides west (still facing south) to just short of the pickup lane, slowly so it stops where it is told: any westward tilt of the 22 in body near the wall puts the bar corner past it, so this short leg is driven sideways.

steps.name: intakeOn
steps.notes: Starts the intake before the pickup (no mid-path markers: Zenith's marker runner calls a Pedro method that Pedro 3.0.2 does not have).
Slowly into the garden line holding the heading square to the west wall (the last 0.35 in west is a tiny slide): the 13.2 in mouth spans all four pollen at once.
Ends early if the robot reports full.
Collects the 4 RED garden pollen nose-first at 0.35 of top speed.
Up to 0.8 s more for the last pollen.

steps.name: intakeOff
steps.notes: Stops the intake.
Backs out north-east (still facing south) to where a 16.8 in turning circle clears the walls.

to.provenance: SET BY HAND: planning choice; 1 in along the next leg's start: a turn on the spot toward the score spot

steps.notes: Turns on the spot to face along the leg back to the hive.

control.provenance: SET BY HAND: planning choice; heads east
SET BY HAND: planning choice; comes up from the south on x = -15, nose to the hive

steps.notes: Nose-first back to the spot south of the hive.

to.provenance: SET BY HAND: planning choice; half an inch on: a turn on the spot to face the south cell

steps.notes: Turns the last few degrees on the spot to face the south cell.

steps.name: score
steps.notes: Volley 2: 4 garden pollen; the south cell reaches 8 and the hive TIPS (tip 1).

to.provenance: SET BY HAND: planning choice; 1 in along the next leg's start: a turn on the spot toward flower0

steps.notes: Turns on the spot to face along the leg to flower0.

control.provenance: SET BY HAND: planning choice; passes south of the hive frame's west foot bar (it ends at y = -19.5)
SET BY HAND: planning choice; lines up on flower0's centre line, heading west

steps.notes: Nose-first to flower0 (the flower near the garden), ending heading west.

steps.name: intakeOn
steps.notes: Starts the intake before the slow approach.

steps.name: flowerBarDown
steps.notes: Puts the flower bar down to reach into flower0's opening.
Slowly nose-in to flower0: the flower bar at its retrieval opening, the intake pulls its 4 pollen.
Waits for the 4th pollen.

steps.name: intakeOff
steps.notes: Stops the intake.

steps.name: flowerBarStow
steps.notes: Folds the flower bar up before backing off.
Backs straight off flower0, still facing it.

to.provenance: SET BY HAND: planning choice; 1 in north: a turn on the spot to face north

steps.notes: Turns on the spot to face north.

control.provenance: SET BY HAND: planning choice; straight north, well west of the hive frame's west foot bar and legs
SET BY HAND: planning choice; 10 in back along the north-cell bearing, so the robot arrives facing the north cell

steps.notes: Nose-first round the WEST side of the hive frame to the spot north of the hive, arriving facing the north cell (up after tip 1).

steps.name: score
steps.notes: Volley 3: 4 flower pollen into the north cell (4 of 8).

to.provenance: SET BY HAND: planning choice; 1 in north: a turn on the spot to face flower1

steps.notes: Turns on the spot to face flower1, straight north.

steps.name: intakeOn
steps.notes: Starts the intake before the slow approach.

steps.name: flowerBarDown
steps.notes: Puts the flower bar down to reach into flower1's opening.
Slowly nose-in to flower1's retrieval opening.
Waits for the 4th pollen.

steps.name: intakeOff
steps.notes: Stops the intake.

steps.name: flowerBarStow
steps.notes: Folds the flower bar up before backing off.

to.provenance: SET BY HAND: planning choice; 1 in north of the score spot, where the turn back starts

steps.notes: Backs straight off flower1, still facing it.
Turns on the spot (over the last inch) to face the north cell.

steps.name: score
steps.notes: Volley 4: the north cell reaches 8 and the hive TIPS again (tip 2).

to.provenance: SET BY HAND: planning choice; 1 in along the next leg's start: a turn on the spot toward the park spot

steps.notes: Turns on the spot to face along the leg to the park spot.
Nose-first to the park spot, partly in RED's loading zone.
